product.title: Highway World — Challenge Mode: Game Night Pricing Crisis
product.summary: A standalone two-round pricing crisis with a facilitator console, separate from the campaign.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students work a revenue-mix board under a demand shock across two rounds, independent of the career campaign. A facilitator console on a separate device collects result codes by alias and produces a compare view for discussion.

delivery.devices: one GPU-capable browser per student, plus a facilitator device

facilitation.prep: Facilitator opens the console, collects result codes, then runs the compare view.

product.technology: same stack as the campaign, in its own lazily loaded chunk

studentDataProfile.notes: Aliases and result codes are typed by the facilitator and stay on that device; nothing syncs. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: Shipped and tested code, but its own session report states the scoring bands are provisional pending playtest data, and it sits outside the campaign's gold-master claim.

health.technicalBasis: Shares the campaign's lack of any deployment.
knownBlockers: Scoring bands are provisional and have not been playtested.
The facilitator console has never been run past a real facilitator for tone and appropriateness.

governance.notes: Recorded separately from the campaign because it is a different length, a different facilitation model and a different pedagogical unit. If BOW would never assign it independently, it should be folded into the campaign entry.

provenance.evidence: docs/CHALLENGE_MODE_SESSION_2_REPORT.md states the scoring bands 'have not been playtested with real students'. Reachable in-app at ?scene=challengearena with its own facilitator and review rooms.
